passages.text: Licensed architecture and engineering design firms are eligible for A&E professional liability when project types are commercial or institutional and contractual limitation of liability is present.
Confirm peer review procedures, continuing education, and contract review protocols before quoting. Design-build exposure requires referral.
Standard A&E limits up to $2,000,000 each claim / $2,000,000 aggregate are within delegated authority. Higher limits require senior approval.
